lessons.title: God made me to know and love him
lessons.idea: God made each of us to know him, love him and be happy with him forever. He gave us a heart to love.
lessons.question: What do you love to do? How can you do it with love?
lessons.activity: Draw yourself with a heart in the middle. Write, “God made me to love.”

lessons.title: God takes care of us
lessons.idea: God our Father takes care of everything he made. He knows each of us by name and gives us what we need.
lessons.question: What do birds and flowers teach us about God?
lessons.activity: Look at pictures of birds and flowers. Thank God for three things he gives.

lessons.title: The first sin and God’s promise
lessons.idea: Adam and Eve chose not to listen to God. This was sin. But God promised to send a Savior.
lessons.question: What does God do after Adam and Eve sin?
lessons.activity: Retell with picture cards: God made the garden, the sin, the promise.

units.title: Stories of God’s friends
units.eq: How does God keep his promises?

lessons.title: Noah and the ark
lessons.idea: God asked Noah to build an ark. Noah listened and trusted God. God made a promise with the rainbow.
lessons.question: Why did Noah build the ark?
lessons.activity: Build a paper boat. Paint a rainbow and say, “God keeps promises.”

lessons.title: Abraham trusts God
lessons.idea: God asked Abraham to leave home and trust him. God promised him many descendants. Abraham believed.
lessons.question: What does it mean to trust someone?
lessons.activity: Look at the night sky or a picture. Count stars as a way to talk about God’s promise.

lessons.title: Moses and the Ten Commandments
lessons.idea: God freed his people from slavery through Moses. He gave them the Ten Commandments so they could live as his people.
lessons.question: Who did God send to free his people?
lessons.activity: Make a “stone tablets” craft and learn the first three commandments.

lessons.title: Jesus is God’s Son
lessons.idea: God sent his Son, Jesus, to save us. Jesus is God and man. He lived with Mary and Joseph in Nazareth.
lessons.question: What did Jesus do when he was a child?
lessons.activity: Draw the Holy Family at home in Nazareth and tell what each person does.

lessons.title: Jesus teaches and heals
lessons.idea: Jesus taught people about God’s love and healed the sick. He chose twelve friends, the apostles, to follow him.
lessons.question: Who were Jesus’ first friends?
lessons.activity: Act out the healing of the paralytic with a classmate lowered on a blanket (carefully).

lessons.title: Jesus dies and rises
lessons.idea: Jesus died on the cross to save us from sin. On the third day he rose from the dead. This is why we celebrate Easter.
lessons.question: What happened on Easter morning?
lessons.activity: Make an empty-tomb scene with a stone and a cloth. Sing “Alleluia.”

units.title: The Holy Spirit and the Church

lessons.title: The Holy Spirit is our helper
lessons.idea: Jesus sent the Holy Spirit to help us. The Spirit came on Pentecost as wind and fire.
lessons.question: What does the Holy Spirit help us do?
lessons.activity: Make paper flames and a red mobile. Pray, “Come, Holy Spirit.”

lessons.title: The Church is God’s family
lessons.idea: The Church is God’s family. The Pope and bishops lead her. All baptized people belong to Jesus’ family.
lessons.question: Who leads the Church?
lessons.activity: Show pictures of the Pope, our bishop and our pastor. Match each to their job.

lessons.title: The Trinity
lessons.idea: There is one God in three Persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit. We say it when we make the Sign of the Cross.
lessons.question: What do we say in the Sign of the Cross?
lessons.activity: Show a shamrock or a three-part drawing. Practice the Sign of the Cross.

lessons.title: Mary, our mother
lessons.idea: Mary is the mother of Jesus. She is also our mother. She said yes to God and helps us say yes too.
lessons.question: What did Mary say to the angel?
lessons.activity: Learn the Hail Mary. Make a small flower garland for Mary.

lessons.title: Saints are our friends
lessons.idea: Saints followed Jesus well. They are in heaven and pray for us. We learn from their lives.
lessons.question: Which saint would you like to meet?
lessons.activity: Read a short story of a saint (Francis, Thérèse, or Patrick). Draw a favorite scene.

lessons.title: Our guardian angels
lessons.idea: God gives each of us a guardian angel. Angels praise God and help us on our way to heaven.
lessons.question: How does your angel help you?
lessons.activity: Practice the Guardian Angel prayer. Draw an angel beside your bed.

units.title: The sacraments
units.eq: How does Jesus stay with us?

lessons.title: Baptism
lessons.idea: In Baptism we are washed with water and receive the Holy Spirit. We become children of God and members of the Church.
lessons.question: What things do we see at a baptism?
lessons.activity: Handle a baptismal candle and shell. Retell the baptism of Jesus.

lessons.title: The Mass
lessons.idea: At Mass we listen to God’s word and share in Jesus’ sacrifice. We receive Jesus in Holy Communion.
lessons.question: What are the two main parts of the Mass?
lessons.activity: Match pictures of the parts of Mass in order.

lessons.title: Being sorry and forgiven
lessons.idea: When we sin we can say sorry. In Reconciliation the priest, in Jesus’ name, forgives us.
lessons.question: Who forgives our sins?
lessons.activity: Practice an examination of conscience with simple questions and an Act of Contrition.

units.title: Living as Jesus’ friends
units.eq: How do friends of Jesus live?

lessons.title: The Golden Rule
lessons.idea: Treat others as you want to be treated. This is how Jesus teaches us to love.
lessons.question: How do you want others to treat you?
lessons.activity: Role-play kind and unkind responses; practice the kind ones.

lessons.title: Obey and honor
lessons.idea: We honor our parents and teachers. We follow rules that keep us safe and help us grow.
lessons.question: Who helps keep you safe?
lessons.activity: Make a thank-you card to a parent or teacher.

lessons.title: Caring for creation and for the poor
lessons.idea: We take care of the world and share with people in need. Jesus cares for the poor.
lessons.question: What can we share?
lessons.activity: Collect canned goods or toys. Plant a small plant.

units.title: Praying and the Church year
units.eq: How do we pray all year?

lessons.title: Ways we pray
lessons.idea: We pray to praise God, to thank him, to ask for help and to say sorry. We can pray anywhere.
lessons.question: What do you want to tell God today?
lessons.activity: Make four prayer cards: Praise, Thanks, Please, Sorry. Pick one to pray.

lessons.title: Our Father and Hail Mary
lessons.idea: Jesus gave us the Our Father. Mary prays with us when we say the Hail Mary.
lessons.question: Which prayer do you like best?
lessons.activity: Pray the Our Father and a decade of the Rosary slowly together.

lessons.title: Advent, Christmas, Lent and Easter
lessons.idea: The Church year helps us remember Jesus. Each season has colors and signs.
lessons.question: What color do we see in Advent? In Easter?
lessons.activity: Color a church-year wheel with purple, white, green and red.
